rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Floribunda.
Registration name: Indiane ®
rows.Bloom: Yellow. (Jaune d'auréoline). Mild fragrance. up to 30 petals. Average diameter 2.5". Medium, full (26-40 petals), in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Medium, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm). Width: up to 20" (up to 50cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
